parsed.rationale: All four records are unnamed extensions on `URLSession` spread across four distinct packages — `Playlist`, `Core`, `Playback`, and `MusicShareKit` — each in a file with a different purpose (`PlaylistFetcher.swift`, `URLSession+WebSession.swift`, `URLSessionProtocol.swift`, `RequestService.swift`). The cluster carries no `fields_or_signature` data for any member, so there is no evidence of shared method bodies or overlapping API surface. The structural signal is purely a name collision on the extended type (`URLSession`), not a duplication of logic. Without field-level evidence of actual overlap, consolidation would risk merging extensions that serve unrelated domain concerns across package boundaries.
